title: Calculate gravitational force
target: Calculate a gravitational interaction with consistent units.
criteria: Identify both masses and the center separation.
Check units and the scale of the result.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: Which entries are needed to compute F = Gm₁m₂/r²?
options: Only one mass and surface altitude.
Both masses and their center-to-center separation.
cpa.guide: The equation depends on two masses and center separation.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A spherical planet has radius 4 × 10⁶ m. A probe is 1 × 10⁶ m above its surface. What r should be used?
cpa.guide: Add radius and altitude before squaring.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A model supplies Gm₁m₂ = 75 N·m² and r = 5 m. What is F?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Gm₁m₂ = 8.0 × 10¹² N·m² and r = 2.0 × 10⁶ m. What is F?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A calculation divides N·m² by m². What unit remains?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A student doubles r but reports twice the gravitational force for unchanged masses. Which check identifies the error?
options: Mass units cancel all distance effects.
Force must grow linearly with distance.
Inverse-square scaling predicts one-quarter the force.
The original force must be zero.
cpa.guide: Check the distance square and whether division was applied correctly.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Select a claim supported by the stated evidence and assumptions.
